run_mkowners_generate_codeowners: run mkowners.py to generate a .github/CODEOWNERS file from OWNERS files in the git repository
run_mkowners_custom_output: run mkowners.py with --out flag to write the CODEOWNERS file to a custom path
parse_owners_file: parse an OWNERS file to extract directives, parent settings, and directory path as an Owners tuple
expand_directives_to_globs: expand OWNERS directives into a mapping of glob patterns to their assigned owners
add_parent_globs: add parent directory ownership rules to child directory globs when parent OWNERS files apply
